chapters.name: MEMBRINA
chapters.source_title: De temperamento colorum in nudis corporibus
content: Named flesh paint for faces and nude bodies. Heat dry unground lead white in copper or iron vessel on live coals until yellow; grind and add white and cenobrium until flesh-like.

Mixture is discretionary: for red faces add more cenobrium; for white faces more white; for pale faces a little prasinus instead of cenobrium. Alternative ingredient sinopis appears in the printed footnote, not the chosen main reading.

chapters.name: PRASINUS
content: Green/black-like compound; do not grind on stone. Dissolve in water, strain through cloth. Useful as green on a fresh wall.

chapters.name: POSC
content: After making membrina and filling faces/nude bodies, add prasinus, red burnt from ochre, and a little cenobrium to make posc.

Use it to mark eyebrows, eyes, nostrils, mouth, chin, hollows around nostrils, temples, forehead/neck wrinkles, facial roundness, young men's beards, hand/foot joints, and all differentiated nude-body members.

chapters.name: ROSA
content: With simple membrina mix a little cenobrium and a little minium to make rosa.
Redden both cheeks, mouth, lower chin, neck and forehead wrinkles moderately; forehead above temples on both sides; nose lengthwise and above nostrils both sides; joints and other nude-body members.

chapters.name: LUMINA
content: Mix ground white with simple membrina to make lumina.

Highlight eyebrows; nose lengthwise and above nostrils both sides; fine strokes around eyes and lower temples; upper chin; beside nostrils and mouth both sides; upper forehead and moderately between its wrinkles; neck middle; around ears; outside hand/foot joints; middles of rounded hands, feet and arms.

chapters.name: VENEDA
content: Mix black and a little white to make veneda; fill pupils. Add more white and fill eyes on both sides. Put plain white between pupil and that color; wash with water.

chapters.name: POSC
content: Take the explicitly previously described posc, not the immediately preceding veneda. Add more prasinus and red so it is a shadow of the previous color.

Fill middle between eyebrows and eyes; middle below eyes; beside nose; between mouth and chin; budding beards; palm halves toward thumb; feet above smaller joints; boys' and women's faces from chin to temples.

chapters.name: ROSA
content: Mix cenobrium with rosa. Put it in the mouth middle while the earlier color stays visible above and below.
Fine strokes over rosa on face, neck and forehead; mark palm joints, connections of all limbs and nails. The prior painted layer is not identical to the paint portion used in the new mixture.

chapters.name: LUMINA
content: Conditional: if the face is dark so one lumina is insufficient, add more white and draw fine strokes over the earlier light throughout. No universal demand for a second layer on every face.
